caption: No visual change by design — report #65 is about the location watch stalling after the app has been open a while, and the fix is in how that watch restarts (it now always carries a timeout, a one-shot network-accuracy retry, and always clears "Locating…"). The shots confirm the app still acquires a location and plans a trip normally; verified separately in a real browser that a hide/show cycle now restarts a single high-accuracy watch WITH a timeout (it had none before), and scripts/gps-tier-check.mjs still passes.
